beats.care: Pandal-hopping in the final days? Go at quieter hours, note the exits, and step back if a crowd feels too tight.
beats.what: A crowd crush at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin pandal killed at least 19 people. CM Suvendu Adhikari said 17 died on the spot.
beats.why: The cause is still being investigated. An eyewitness told The Statesman the entry and exit gates were both narrow.

cards.body: The state also promised a government job to each family, ₹5 lakh to each injured person, and free treatment.
cards.caption: aid for each family that lost someone

cards.body: Of the 25 injured, 24 are out of danger and one is critical, the CM said. The injured were taken to Calcutta Medical College. The PMO asked the Chief Secretary for a report, which has been sent.
cards.title: Where things stand

opts: Work out what caused the crush and who was responsible
cards.q: What will a fact-finding committee mainly do here?
cards.why: The CM wants a team with STF and forensic experts to find out how the crush happened.
